text:
Young people follow singers, footballers and film stars on screens every day, and many feel that celebrities have a negative influence on them. I agree to some extent, since some celebrities set a poor example, although others have a very positive influence.

To begin with, celebrities can set a negative example for young fans. Young people imitate stars who display luxury, extreme diets or reckless behaviour. A teenager who sees an idol spend huge sums on fashion and cars, for example, may feel that happiness depends on money and may try to copy that lifestyle. Pictures of unnaturally thin models and edited bodies can lead to dissatisfaction with appearance and eating problems, and scandals involving drugs, alcohol or violence may make such behaviour seem acceptable. Because fans often look up to their idols, they may defend their actions or follow their habits without thinking about the consequences. Many stars also promote products in return for payment, which encourages young people to buy things they do not need.

However, many celebrities inspire positive habits. Athletes and artists who work hard, give to charity or speak about mental health encourage young people to do the same. A footballer who grew up in poverty and now funds schools, for example, shows what discipline and generosity can achieve. Musicians who talk openly about their own struggles help fans to feel less alone, and actors who support environmental campaigns raise awareness among their followers. The influence therefore depends on which role models are promoted. Parents and teachers can help by discussing the lives of public figures critically and by drawing attention to those who offer genuine examples.

In conclusion, I agree to some extent that celebrities can influence young people negatively, but the overall effect depends on the example that they set.

analysis.type_vi: Agree/Disagree: người nổi tiếng ảnh hưởng tiêu cực tới giới trẻ — agree một phần

plan.think: Mở bài nêu người trẻ theo dõi ca sĩ, cầu thủ, ngôi sao; agree một phần.

Làm gương xấu: bắt chước xa hoa, ăn kiêng cực đoan, liều lĩnh; ví dụ thiếu niên thấy thần tượng tiêu tiền thời trang, xe nghĩ hạnh phúc là tiền; người mẫu gầy, chỉnh sửa gây không hài lòng ngoại hình, rối loạn ăn uống; bê bối ma tuý, rượu bia, bạo lực; quảng cáo trả tiền.

Nhiều người truyền cảm hứng: vận động viên, nghệ sĩ chăm chỉ, từ thiện, nói về sức khoẻ tâm thần; ví dụ cầu thủ lớn lên nghèo nay tài trợ trường; nhạc sĩ nói về khó khăn giúp fan bớt cô đơn; diễn viên vận động môi trường; phụ huynh, giáo viên thảo luận phản biện.
Tuỳ tấm gương họ đặt ra.
